def factor_intraday_vol_asym_persistence_ewm90(df):
    """Asymmetric intraday volatility clustering persistence with longer EWMA smoothing."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    ret = intraday_ret
    pos_ret = ret.clip(lower=0.0)
    neg_ret = ret.clip(upper=0.0)
    pos_persist = (pos_ret**2 * pos_ret.shift(1)**2).ewm(span=90, min_periods=40).mean()
    neg_persist = (neg_ret**2 * neg_ret.shift(1)**2).ewm(span=90, min_periods=40).mean()
    total_persist = pos_persist + neg_persist
    factor = (neg_persist - pos_persist) / total_persist.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_intraday_vol_asym_persistence_ewm90"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_vol_asym_persistence_ewm90"]
